Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 14352 of 2023

Applicant :- Jhamman @ Safi Mohammad
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Mukul Yadav,Ram Jatan Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Akhilesh Srivastava,Saksham Srivastava
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed today on behalf of the applicant is taken on record.

2. Heard Sri Ram Jatan Yadav, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Saksham Srivastava, learned counsel for the informant and Sri Suresh Bahadur Singh, learned AGA for the State.
3.

The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 353 of 2022, under Sections 147, 323, 366, 376-D, 504, 506 IPC, Police Station Dadon, District Aligarh during pendency of the trial.

4. FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and seven others under Sections 147,
323, 366, 504, 506 IPC and according to the FIR, applicant and other accused persons on the gun-point abducted the daughter of the informant.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that totally on the basis of false allegation applicant has been made accused in the present matter along with other accused persons.

He further submits,
however, victim during investigation supported the version of the FIR and stated against the applicant and other accused persons and even after considering her statement recorded during investigation bail application of co-accused Bhura was dismissed by this Bench vide order dated 24.07.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 31079 of 2023 but when informant of the case appeared before the trial court then she did not support the prosecution case and she has been declared hostile, however, he fairly conceded that till date statement of the victim could not be recorded by the trial court.
6.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 31079 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
He further submits that after rejection of bail application of co-accused Bhura by this Bench, the bail application of co-accused Arif @ Tunna has been allowed by the co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 26.09.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 39399 of 2023 and case of applicant is exactly at par with co-accused Arif @ Tunna, therefore, even on the ground of parity,
applicant may be enlarged on bail.
7.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 39399 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: He further submits that law is settled that there can be no parity of bail rejection order.

He further submits that admittedly victim is major girl and she in fact was having love affair with co-accused Bhura and applicant has falsely been implicated in the present matter as he is neighbor of co-accused Bhura and after considering the entire facts of the case, co-accused Arif @ Tunna has been enlarged on bail by the co-ordinate Bench of this Court.
8. He further submits that applicant is not having any previous criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 01.11.2022 i.e. for more than a year.
9. Per contra, learned AGA as well as learned counsel for the informant opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact that victim is major girl.

They further could not dispute, allegation of gang rape was against the applicant and others and co-accused Arif @ Tunna has already been release on bail by the co-ordinate Bench of this Court and case of applicant is at par with him.

10. Learned counsel for the informant however further submitted that this Bench has rejected the bail application of co-accused Bhura but he could not dispute the fact that after rejection of bail application of co-accused Bhura, bail application of co-accused Arif @ Tunna has been allowed by the co-ordinate Bench of this Court and case of applicant is at par with him.
He further could not dispute the fact that applicant is not having any previous criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 01.11.2022 i.e. for more than a year.
11. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

12. However, from the record, it reflects that in the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. she made allegation of rape against four persons including applicant, co-accused Arif @
Tunna, Bhura and Gatua and after considering the facts of the case bail application of co-accused Bhura was dismissed by this Court but from the record, it reflects that after rejection of bail application of co-accused Bhura, bail application of co-accused Arif @ Tunna was allowed by the Jhamman @ Safi Mohammad vs State Of U.P. on 16 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88051226/
2 co-ordinate Bench of this Court on 26.09.2023 and case of applicant is at par with him.
13.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. CBI & another (2022) 10 SCC 51 in paragraph no. 98 has observed that:-
"Uniformity and certainty in the decisions of the court are the foundations of judicial dispensation.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil Vs. CBI & another (2022) 10 SCC 51
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Persons accused with same offence shall never be treated differently either by the same court or by the same or different courts.

Such an action though by an exercise of discretion despite being a judicial one would be a grave affront to Articles 14 and 15 of the Constitution of India."
14.
This Court find force in the argument advanced by learned counsel for the applicant that law is settled that there can be no parity of bail rejection order.
15. Further, applicant is not having any previous criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 01.11.2022 i.e. for more than a year.

16. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, particularly the fact that co-accused Arif @ Tunna has been released on bail and case of applicant is at par with him and applicant is in jail since 01.11.2022 i.e. for more than a year, in my view, applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
17. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

18. Let the applicant - Jhamman @ Safi Mohammad be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
19. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

20. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
